description: This file declares the RDKWindowManager class, which implements plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for managing window-related functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It also defines an internal Notification class for handling remote connection events and user inactivity notifications.

classes.name: RDKWindowManager
classes.description: Main class implementing plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for RDK window management, including lifecycle methods, internal state, and notification handling.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Internal class handling remote connection notifications and user inactivity events, associated with RDKWindowManager.
